explanation: Implemented Apache Commons CSV 1.10.0 behavior for parse_csv and print_csv according to the contract. The parser faithfully implements ExtendedBufferedReader, Lexer, Token, handleNull logic, line/record counting, and quote-mode handling, reproducing all whitespace trimming, escape/delimiter parsing, and null vs empty string translations. The printer mirrors CSVFormat and CSVPrinter quoting/escaping policies (MINIMAL, ALL, ALL_NON_NULL, NON_NUMERIC, NONE) as well as record/trailing delimiters. Standard library exceptions CSVParseError and IllegalArgumentException are raised when format violations or parsing errors occur.
